title: An Isolation Forest IDS that passes on synthetic traffic and misses DoS on real traffic
summary: My Python IDS caught three of four synthetic attack types. On 2.3 million real CIC-IDS2017 flows it caught none of the DoS Hulk or DDoS traffic. What the test showed and why.
